YES

The slice boundaries match the spec exactly: `0:320`, `384:768`, `768:1088`, `1152:1536`, `1536:1856`, `1920:2304` on the column axis of `c_attn.weight` and on `c_attn.bias` (removing the 64-wide head-5 block from each of the q, k, v segments), and `0:320` + `384:768` on the row axis of `c_proj.weight`, giving `[768, 2112]`, `[2112]` and `[704, 768]`. Pieces are concatenated in the required order (`dim: 1` for the weight, `dim: 0` for the bias and `c_proj`), the originals are deleted before being rebuilt under their unchanged names, all temporaries are removed, and every other tensor passes through untouched. All four required checks are present as `assert` transforms before the single output file `out/T2/model.safetensors`.
